reference_domain.normal: All rawinput/control values finite. For scalar internal-clock approximation, f32(f32(tempo+f32(tempoCV*amount))+127) in[0,255); scalar integer exponent0..254 ensures representable nonnegative leftshift and finiteapproximation. Include zero exponent, highfinite and fractional boundary cases. Externalclock connects preserve same domain in schedule for simple declaration.
reference_domain.pulse_and_phase: SDK PulseGenerator subtracts f32dt only while remaining>0; passthrough freezes clockPulse remaining. Internal reset guard mayallow phase>=1, evenhugefinite, until a later accepted crossing truncates it. No real-number interval assumptions.
reference_domain.safety: Rust-only fixtures exercise NaN/Inf/extremeCV and out-of-domain exponents with recovery. Require finite outputs/state, bounded discrete state and declared policies; no SDK oracle executed and no out-of-domain numerical equivalence claim. Production safetyextension must keep phasefinite/nonnegative; nonfiniteinput maps0.
